assets.name: cereal
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a flat print-ready front-label texture to wrap onto a genuinely modeled cereal box in an educational 3D kitchen. Create only the rectangular packaging artwork, tall 2:3 aspect, edge to edge, perfectly straight orthographic front, no physical box, no perspective, no background, no shadow or border outside the label. Rich glossy royal blue cereal packaging, large crisp white words exactly 'RICE KRISPIES' and smaller 'CEREAL'. A detailed photorealistic bowl of crisp toasted rice cereal, a natural splash of milk, golden cereal kernels and a small silver spoon fill the lower half. Professional supermarket packaging with sophisticated highlights, delicious food photography and fine print-like graphic detail. No nutrition facts, no health claims, no weight or price, no characters, no watermark. The lettering must be readable and spelled correctly. This is a texture asset, not a scene or UI.
